lines.trans: This shoot is particularly rough today.
You did twenty-seven difficult takes.
I smashed through that door twenty-seven times!
We must prepare the next scene.
I still have a few minutes of rest.
We have to do your whole body with makeup.
Is this the death scene?
Yes, exactly, it is that scene.
But my character is inside a bag!
Pascal asked for full-body makeup.
Why put makeup on my entire body?
I do not know, these are orders.
Pascal is preparing a nasty surprise.
Come and sit down in makeup.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: To take care of one's body.

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: encore une heure = one more hour

examples.text: Pour les enfants du monde entier.
examples.trans: For the children of the whole world.

meanings.note: le monde entier = the whole world
also as an answer: Exactement! = That's right!
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen

examples.trans: I'm going to have lunch twice.

meanings.note: une fois, deux fois = once, twice
raconter une histoire = to tell a story

examples.text: Je dois régler ce problème immédiatement.
examples.trans: I must settle this problem immediately.

installer.gloss: to install, to settle in, to move in

meanings.en: s'installer = to settle in, move in

examples.text: Il vient de s'installer dans un nouvel immeuble.
examples.trans: He just moved into a new building.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: usually before the noun: une mauvaise nouvelle

examples.text: Monsieur Audibert nous reçoit dans cinq minutes.
examples.trans: Mr Audibert will see us in five minutes.

meanings.note: past participle of mourir, used as an adjective
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
donner des ordres = to give orders

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Laissez la porte ouverte, s'il vous plaît.

meanings.note: laisser la porte ouverte = to leave the door open

examples.text: Samir dit qu'il a de bonnes prises.
examples.trans: Samir says he has some good takes.

examples.text: Elle a peur de rater quelque chose.

examples.text: Pose ton sac sur la table.
examples.trans: Put your bag on the table.

savoir.gloss: to know; to know how to

meanings.note: je ne sais pas = I don't know
une scène d'amour = a love scene

examples.trans: Let's move on to the next scene.

examples.text: Je voulais te faire la surprise.

meanings.note: faire la surprise à = to surprise someone

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
